why: Makes the transgyrans crossing (two mirror gyrans meeting and parting) a stable morph instead of a passing state; the other Z18A9R morphs change by under 0.5 % in mass (MORPH.md, output/transgyrans/tune/).

Makes trigyrans (three gyrans rotating round a common centre) a stable morph instead of a passing state that replicates after ~500 steps: 35 of 36 runs hold it for 6,000 steps (none before). The other Z18A9R morphs keep their form; gyrans' mass -2.5 % and turn rate -13 %, the rest within ~1.5 % (MORPH.md, output/z18a9r_new/).
